providers.name: OpenAI
providers.notes: Model IDs/context from developers.openai.com/api/docs/models. Chat Completions also supported (gpt-6-luna page). Base URL, key URL, /models from prior knowledge, not re-fetched.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.notes: Requires anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 header (from prior knowledge). Models API documented at platform.claude.com. Haiku 4.5 retirement not sooner than 2026-10-15.

providers.name: Google Gemini (AI Studio)
providers.notes: Native path models/{model}:generateContent / :streamGenerateContent (prior knowledge). OpenAI-compatible alt: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai (verified; /chat/completions, Bearer key). Key can alternatively be sent as ?key= query param. Pro-tier model ID not found on stable list.

providers.name: Google Cloud Vertex AI

baseUrlParams.name: project_id
baseUrlParams.label: GCP Project ID (optional with a Vertex API key; defaults to the service-account JSON's project)

providers.notes: Gemini native API on Vertex AI (publishers/google/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent). Three ways to authenticate, all pasted in the key field: (1) a Vertex AI API key (express mode; project_id optional); (2) the full service-account JSON key file (needs roles/aiplatform.user; an OAuth token is minted and refreshed automatically, project_id defaults to the JSON's); (3) a short-lived OAuth access token from `gcloud auth print-access-token` (ya29…, expires in ~1 h; requires project_id). GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing to a JSON key file is also honored. Location 'global' uses https://aiplatform.googleapis.com; regional locations use https://{location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com. Billing goes through Google Cloud; prices mirror the Gemini API list prices.

providers.name: Microsoft Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry
providers.notes: v1 API: no api-version needed; model field is the user's DEPLOYMENT name, so no fixed fallback models. Key auth via api-key header (Entra ID uses Authorization: Bearer with scope https://ai.azure.com/.default). Alt host {resource}.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1. Chat Completions works for non-OpenAI models (DeepSeek, Grok); Responses recommended for OpenAI models. Docs examples use trailing slash; omit it. /models listing not confirmed on the fetched page.

providers.name: Amazon Bedrock
providers.notes: Use Converse/InvokeModel on bedrock-runtime (SigV4), or a long-term Bedrock API key sent as Authorization: Bearer (AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK). Model listing is on the separate control-plane host bedrock.{region}.amazonaws.com (GET /foundation-models). Geo/global inference profiles use prefixes us./eu./global. (e.g. us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0). Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint bedrock-mantle: https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/v1 (not supported for all models; Nova 2 Lite no).

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.notes: IDs from docs.mistral.ai models overview; context windows not listed there. FIM endpoint is /v1/fim/completions (Codestral). Codestral may also be served from codestral.mistral.ai. Key URL from prior knowledge.

providers.name: xAI (Grok)
providers.notes: Chat Completions is documented as a LEGACY endpoint; Responses API (/v1/responses) is primary and gets new features first. Key URL and /models from prior knowledge.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.notes: Base URL has no /v1 (docs); /v1 also accepted historically. Anthropic-format endpoint: https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic. Legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp still accepted (served by Flash). FIM beta uses https://api.deepseek.com/beta (prior knowledge, not re-verified). Flash supports vision per docs; Pro vision not stated. Key URL from prior knowledge.

providers.name: Meta Model API (Llama / Muse)
providers.notes: Meta's API (formerly llama.developer.meta.com, now dev.meta.ai) serves Muse Spark models, not Llama; Llama weights are open and available via other hosts. Supports Chat Completions, Responses and Messages protocols. Key creation page not found in fetched docs (keyUrl null). Vision/jsonMode flags assumed from multimodal description, not confirmed.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.notes: OpenAI-compat endpoint verified; docs do not list /models there (native API has /v1/models), so listModels is unconfirmed for compat path. Native adapter alternative: https://api.cohere.com/v2. Unsupported on compat: logit_bias, documents, connectors.

providers.name: AI21 Labs
providers.notes: Endpoint is /chat/completions with OpenAI-like request shape (model, messages, Bearer auth) but docs do not explicitly state OpenAI compatibility; no models-list endpoint documented. Dated ids exist (jamba-large-1.7-2025-07, jamba-mini-2-2026-01); docs recommend pinning. Streaming incompatible with tools.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notes: Optional attribution headers HTTP-Referer and X-OpenRouter-Title. Model list is huge and changes constantly; always use listModels. Anthropic id slug 'anthropic/claude-opus-5.5' is inferred from the models list display name and should be checked via /models.

providers.name: Groq
providers.notes: LPU inference. Preview models (Qwen etc.) are evaluation only. Whisper models are speech-to-text.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.notes: Context shown is paid tier (free tier is about half). Very small model roster in Shared Inference; more via Dedicated. /models endpoint returns 401 without key (confirms existence).

providers.name: SambaNova
providers.notes: Base URL confirmed by live /v1/models response (public). Preview models (MiniMax-M3, DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it) may be removed at short notice.

providers.name: Together AI
providers.notes: Base URL inferred from live endpoint (https://api.together.ai/v1/models returns 401) rather than quoted from docs page. Model ids from official serverless models page.

providers.name: Fireworks AI
providers.notes: Model ids use accounts/fireworks/models/ prefix. Also exposes an Anthropic-compatible endpoint at https://api.fireworks.ai/inference. Context lengths not confirmed. /models path not explicitly confirmed in quickstart. Model ids derived from the official pricing/model pages (accounts/fireworks/models/<slug>); confirm with the live /models list.

providers.name: DeepInfra
providers.notes: /models confirmed via live public response. Supports MODEL:VERSION and deploy_id:ID model references.

providers.name: Perplexity (Sonar)
providers.notes: Sonar Chat Completions is deprecated; per migration docs support ended 2026-09-27. Replacement is the Agent API (input/output typed array, presets fast/low/high/xhigh), which is NOT OpenAI chat-completions shaped and needs a custom adapter. Sonar ids sonar, sonar-pro, sonar-reasoning-pro, sonar-deep-research. Context lengths not confirmed.

providers.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible router is chat-only. Append :fastest/:cheapest/:preferred or :provider to model id. Token needs fine-grained 'Make calls to Inference Providers' permission. Embeddings/image need HF clients, not this endpoint.

providers.name: Replicate
providers.notes: requires custom adapter: docs show only native POST /v1/predictions (owner/name model ids, Bearer auth); no OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint could be confirmed. Base URL is native API root.

providers.name: Novita AI
providers.notes: Base URL and example model id confirmed in docs. Only one model id confirmed with exact id; use /models to list others. Capability flags (tools/vision/json) and keyUrl not verified from docs.

providers.name: Hyperbolic
providers.notes: Endpoint https://api.hyperbolic.xyz/v1/chat/completions seen via search snippets only; docs moved to hyperbolic.ai/docs (docs pages did not yield details). Model ids from search results, not confirmed; several models announced for sunset (GPT-OSS, Qwen3-Next). Use /models. Env var and keyUrl are conventional guesses.

providers.name: Nebius Token Factory
providers.notes: Base URL confirmed (docs show trailing slash; omitted). Formerly Nebius AI Studio. Model ids from docs examples may be dated; use /models?verbose=true. Docs show DeepSeek-R1-0528 in examples. Capability flags not individually verified.

providers.name: Lambda Inference
providers.notes: Lambda states the Inference API is winding down in favor of self-hosting on Lambda GPU instances (lambda.ai/inference); search reports announcement dated 2026-05-29. Not recommended for new setups.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
providers.notes: Endpoint POST /v1/chat/completions confirmed. Docs list gpt-oss 20b/120b among hosted models (vendor-prefixed ids assumed standard). Catalog changes frequently (Nemotron 3, DeepSeek V4, Kimi K3 listed at build.nvidia.com); use /models. Keys start with nvapi-; keyUrl not verified.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.notes: Base URL, chat/embeddings/responses endpoints confirmed. API key is a Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permission. /v1/models not confirmed in OpenAI-compat docs (modelsEndpoint null); Responses API only for gpt-oss, non-streaming. Catalog has ~69 models.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.notes: GitHub docs state GitHub Models (playground, catalog, inference API, BYOK) fully retired as of 2026-07-30. Suggested alternatives: Azure AI Foundry, GitHub Copilot. Base URL is the historical one.

providers.name: IBM watsonx.ai

baseUrlParams.name: region
baseUrlParams.label: Region (us-south, eu-de, eu-gb, jp-tok, au-syd, ca-tor)

providers.notes: requires custom adapter: native chat is POST /ml/v1/text/chat (and /text/chat_stream) with required ?version=YYYY-MM-DD query param and project_id/space_id in body; auth is an IBM Cloud IAM bearer token obtained by exchanging the API key (not the raw key). No OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions confirmed. Regional hosts: us-south, eu-de, eu-gb, jp-tok, au-syd, ca-tor (.ml.cloud.ibm.com), Mumbai ap-south-1.aws.wxai.ibm.com. Model ids from docs table; some models deprecated.

providers.name: Databricks Model Serving
providers.notes: Model IDs verified from supported-models page. Base URL /serving-endpoints is the documented OpenAI-client pattern (not spelled out on fetched page); endpoint availability varies by cloud/region. Auth is a PAT or OAuth token. Model list is via workspace API, not /models.

providers.name: Snowflake Cortex
providers.notes: Auth via PAT, JWT or OAuth bearer token. Model availability varies by region; model names summarized from docs (llama ids not fully confirmed verbatim, check region table). Also has /messages Anthropic-compatible endpoint. No documented models list endpoint.

providers.name: Writer (Palmyra)
providers.notes: requires custom adapter: documented chat endpoint is POST https://api.writer.com/v1/chat (not /chat/completions); docs do not claim OpenAI compatibility. Request shape is OpenAI-like (messages, tools, stream). /models endpoint and keyUrl not confirmed. Palmyra X5/X4 retire 2026-12-14.

providers.name: Upstage (Solar)
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions confirmed. Context windows, vision, embeddings flag and keyUrl not confirmed from fetched pages. Also lists syn-pro model. reasoning_effort param supported.

providers.name: Reka
providers.notes: Docs state any OpenAI SDK works with base URL and key change. tools/jsonMode/listModels not confirmed; conservatively false.

providers.name: Scaleway Generative APIs
providers.notes: Endpoints /chat/completions, /responses, /embeddings, /models, /rerank. Hosted in France/EU. Model IDs from official supported-models page; catalog changes often, prefer /models.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.notes: Base URL from third-party integration docs (not OVH page fetched). Key created in Manager under Public Cloud > AI & ML > AI Endpoints; project needs payment method. Anonymous use allowed at 2 req/min/IP. Model IDs are case/underscore sensitive; catalog changes, use /models. /models existence not directly confirmed.

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen)
providers.notes: Current docs show workspace-specific Singapore URL. Legacy shared URL https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 is still cited by third parties and may still work. API keys are region-bound (Singapore key for intl endpoint; Beijing keys fail with 401). Other regions: us, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Beijing (cn-beijing). Context windows not shown.

providers.name: Moonshot AI (Kimi)
providers.notes: Base URL, key URL, context windows and OpenAI+Anthropic compatibility confirmed. Exact API model ID strings were inferred from display names (docs page summary gave names, not literal IDs); verify. China endpoint is api.moonshot.cn/v1. Docs moved to platform.kimi.ai.

providers.name: Zhipu AI / Z.ai (GLM)
providers.notes: Base URL confirmed; chat at /chat/completions. GLM-5.3 text-only, reasoning always on, 1M context/128K output. Model code casing (lowercase) assumed; keyUrl and /models not confirmed from docs. China endpoint: https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4. Separate coding-plan endpoint exists at /api/coding/paas/v4.

providers.name: MiniMax
providers.notes: Also offers Anthropic-compatible endpoint https://api.minimax.io/anthropic. China mainland endpoint is https://api.minimaxi.com/v1 (not verified here). MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview exists but only via M Plan/MiniMax Code. Reasoning on by default. keyUrl and /models listing not verified in docs fetched.

providers.name: Baidu Qianfan (ERNIE)
providers.notes: Base URL and Bearer auth (key format bce-v3/ALTAK-...) confirmed in official docs; ERNIE model IDs taken from secondary sources, not the official model list. Qianfan also hosts third-party models (e.g. deepseek-v3.1-250821). Some requests accept an 'appid' header. keyUrl and modelsEndpoint unverified.

providers.name: 01.AI (Yi)
providers.notes: Base URL api.lingyiwanwu.com/v1 and yi-lightning seen only in third-party sources (Portkey, LangChain); official docs page did not render details. 01.AI pivoted away from public API LLM business so service may be deprecated or changed. Verify before shipping. Context values and other model IDs unconfirmed.

providers.name: Tencent Hunyuan
providers.notes: Official docs list models hunyuan-turbos-latest, hunyuan-t1-latest, hunyuan-lite, hunyuan-vision, hunyuan-embedding. Docs note service is migrating to TokenHub (existing services continue). stop param stops AFTER the match (differs from OpenAI). Default concurrency 5. Context windows not confirmed. /models listing unverified.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible at /v1; default port 11434. API key not required (any dummy value accepted; bearer optional if behind a proxy). Models listed via /v1/models. Not re-verified against docs this session.

providers.name: LM Studio (local)
providers.notes: Local server default port 1234, started from LM Studio Developer tab. No key required (bearer optional/ignored). Not re-verified this session.

providers.name: vLLM (local server)
providers.notes: `vllm serve <model>` default port 8000. Auth none unless started with --api-key (then bearer). Embeddings only for embedding models; vision for multimodal models; tools need --enable-auto-tool-choice. Not re-verified this session.

providers.name: llama.cpp server (llama-server)
providers.notes: llama-server default port 8080. Auth none unless --api-key (then bearer). Serves one loaded model; /v1/models returns it. FIM via /infill (non-OpenAI path). Tools require --jinja. Not re-verified this session.

providers.name: LocalAI (local)
providers.notes: Default port 8080. Auth none unless API keys configured (then bearer). Not re-verified this session.

providers.name: Jan (local)
providers.notes: Jan local API server default port 1337; requires enabling server in settings. Jan's API server typically requires an API key (bearer) set in its settings - treat as optional/configurable. Not re-verified this session.

providers.name: Chutes
providers.notes: Verified via public https://llm.chutes.ai/v1/models (14 models listed, prices in USD/M). Pay-per-token with Chutes credits; subscription plans also exist. Cheapest: Mistral Nemo / Nemotron Nano at $0.0245 in / $0.0978 out. Model IDs carry -TEE suffix.

providers.name: SiliconFlow (International)
providers.notes: Prices from siliconflow.com/pricing; /v1/models exists but requires API key (401 without) so exact model IDs follow SiliconFlow HF-style naming and are NOT verified. New accounts get ~$1 free credits. Mainland site is siliconflow.cn (separate, CNY). Model ids follow Hugging Face naming but could not be checked without a key; the live /models list replaces them once connected.

providers.name: Featherless AI
providers.notes: Public /models lists ~22k HF models with per-token prices (shown prices are those; Developer plan $50/mo is billed per token, Chat plan $25/mo flat unlimited tokens, 32K ctx, 4 concurrency units). Catalog is huge; only 3 cheap useful chat models listed. Tool support varies per model.

providers.name: Inference.net
providers.notes: Verified via public /v1/models (65 models, USD per token converted to per 1M). Also proxies closed models (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) at provider-like prices. Cheapest chat: Llama 3.2 1B at $0.027/$0.201.

providers.name: Parasail
providers.notes: Prices from parasail.io/pricing (serverless, pay as you go, no minimums). /v1/models requires API key (401), so exact model IDs are best-guess HF names and NOT verified; fetch the live list. Context lengths unknown where null. Model ids follow Hugging Face naming but could not be checked without a key; the live /models list replaces them once connected.

providers.name: Friendli AI (Serverless)
providers.notes: Verified via public https://api.friendli.ai/serverless/v1/models (7 models, prices converted to per 1M). Pay-per-token; small catalog. Rest not listed: GLM-5.1/5.2 at $1.40/$4.40.

providers.name: StepFun (international)
providers.notes: Prices from platform.stepfun.ai pricing page (cache-hit input cheaper: 0.02-0.05). /models requires key (401 without). Context for 3.5-flash not confirmed.

providers.name: BytePlus ModelArk (Seed / Doubao)
providers.notes: International endpoint confirmed (401 without key on /models). Prices/IDs from third-party sources (apiyi, pricepertoken), not official docs (docs pages not scrapeable). Lite is tiered: >128K ctx 0.50/4.00. Older seed-1-6-flash ~0.075/0.30. Some models need endpoint IDs (ep-...) or activation in console. China endpoint (Volcengine): https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3.

providers.name: Avian.io
providers.notes: Public /models listing verified live with pricing. No free tier found. Tools/vision flags are assumed, not in listing.

providers.name: AI/ML API
providers.notes: Public /models lists 380 chat models (verified live) but exposes no prices; prices left null. Free tier limited/trial only, unverified. Models also accept short aliases.

providers.name: Requesty
providers.notes: Public /models (759 entries, provider/model IDs) verified live. Router passes through provider prices, no markup. Zero-priced entries (nemotron, gemma-4) look free but may be listing artifacts/limited. EU base: https://router.eu.requesty.ai/v1.

providers.name: Venice.ai
providers.notes: Public /models verified live with USD pricing. Also supports Venice DIEM credits. Venice adds extra params via venice_parameters (web search, etc.).
